COO's public 2026 leadership post links Eva Wong's professional profile; no warm introduction or willingness to purchase confirmed.
Issuer annual report explicitly dates the HRIS go-live to September 2018.
Company describes its LF AI Portal and enhanced generative-AI use in FY2024; internal development is technology investment, not verified purchase of a Workday-adjacent vendor.

why_now: A mature global Workday footprint supports ongoing configuration changes, performance cycles, learning and ESG reporting. CTO-led AI adoption and a CHRO who returned in 2025 suggest a possible modernization discussion; no recent go-live or committed testing purchase was found.
